lines.zh: 我沿着河底巡游，牙齿一直露在外面。
lines.en: I cruise along the riverbed with my teeth always showing.

lines.zh: 我游得很直，像一把锯在切水。
lines.en: I swim dead straight, like a saw cutting through water.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑过去，惊起一小片泥。
lines.en: I skim the sandy bottom and start a small cloud of silt.

lines.zh: 前面的鱼群散了，因为我来了。
lines.en: The school ahead scatters, because I have arrived.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，没有减速。
lines.en: I round a stone without slowing down.

lines.zh: 河流的弯道，我从不用拐两次。
lines.en: On a river bend, I never have to turn twice.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍切开水面，留下一道细线。
lines.en: My dorsal fin cuts the surface and leaves a thin line.

lines.zh: 我跟着血腥味走，方向很清楚。
lines.en: I follow the smell of blood; the direction is clear.

lines.zh: 我从桥下游过，阴影替我挡了光。
lines.en: I pass under the bridge, and its shadow shields me from light.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但路线从不改。
lines.en: I do not swim fast, but I never change my route.

lines.zh: 河水推着我，我顺势滑进更深的一段。
lines.en: The river pushes me, and I slide into a deeper stretch.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼在我前面逃，我慢慢跟上。
lines.en: A shoal of small fish flees ahead, and I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 我靠近岸边，又折回河心。
lines.en: I drift toward the bank, then turn back to midstream.

lines.zh: 我张嘴的时候，水流能看见我的牙。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, the current can see my teeth.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁游，牙尖刮出白痕。
lines.en: I swim by the rock face, teeth scraping white marks.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，我只抬眼看一眼。
lines.en: I glance once at the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我停在暗处，牙齿还在轻轻磨。
lines.en: I stop in the dark, teeth still grinding softly.

lines.zh: 河底的石头缝里，我在等谁经过。
lines.en: In a crack of the riverbed, I wait for something to pass.

lines.zh: 水草挡住我一半的身体，正好。
lines.en: The weeds hide half my body, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，让水从我鳃里流过。
lines.en: I sway my tail slowly and let water pass through my gills.

lines.zh: 刚才那条鱼，现在只剩鳞了。
lines.en: That fish from before is nothing but scales now.

lines.zh: 我把牙关松开又合上，听那个声音。
lines.en: I loosen my jaw and close it again, listening to the sound.

lines.zh: 河面很亮，我待在下面。
lines.en: The surface is bright, and I stay below it.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，比动的时候更吓人。
lines.en: When I am still, I am scarier than when I move.

lines.zh: 有只蜻蜓点水，我抬头看了看。
lines.en: A dragonfly dips the water, and I glance up.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还卡着一点骨头。
lines.en: A bit of bone is still stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我在数经过的鱼，已经数到第四条。
lines.en: I am counting the fish that pass; I have reached four.

lines.zh: 水流变凉了，我知道傍晚到了。
lines.en: The current cools, and I know evening has come.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴在河床上，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I press my body to the riverbed and become almost invisible.

lines.zh: 耐心是这条河教我的第一件事。
lines.en: Patience is the first thing this river taught me.

lines.zh: 你在岸边洗手，我就在下面看着。
lines.en: You wash your hands at the bank, and I watch from below.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一点，让你看见我的牙。
lines.en: I rise a little so you can see my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在水面晃，我盯着它。
lines.en: Your reflection wavers on the surface, and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，很好，你懂了。
lines.en: You took a step back; good, you understand.

lines.zh: 我绕着你浸在水里的脚游了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the foot you have in the water.

lines.zh: 你的手指离水面只有一格。
lines.en: Your fingers are only one block from the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: I lift my head and set my eyes on yours.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我们的距离缩短了一半。
lines.en: When you bend down, the distance between us halves.

lines.zh: 我知道你身上有几处能咬。
lines.en: I know how many places on you could be bitten.

lines.zh: 我们就这么看着，谁都没有动。
lines.en: We just look at each other, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被削掉一片，水里有血。
lines.en: A scale is sliced off, and blood stains the water.

lines.zh: 疼得我一头扎进石头缝。
lines.en: The pain sends me diving headfirst into a stone crack.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我牙齿都合不上。
lines.en: That blow leaves my jaw unable to close.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，又强撑着正过来。
lines.en: I flip over, then force myself upright again.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍破了一个口子。
lines.en: A hole is torn in my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我游得很歪，牙还张着。
lines.en: I swim crooked with my teeth still bared.

lines.zh: 你的武器比我的牙硬，这次。
lines.en: Your weapon is harder than my teeth, this time.

lines.zh: 我退到暗处，先喘口气。
lines.en: I retreat into the dark to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 血一直流，河里的味道变了。
lines.en: The blood keeps flowing, and the river's taste changes.

lines.zh: 我没死，只是记住了你的样子。
lines.en: I am not dead; I have only memorized your shape.

lines.zh: 你扔下的鱼，我一口就接住了。
lines.en: The fish you drop, I catch in one bite.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，就知道有东西吃。
lines.en: I smell blood and know there is something to eat.

lines.zh: 那块肉沉下来，我连犹豫都没有。
lines.en: The meat sinks down, and I do not hesitate at all.

lines.zh: 你的饵很好，但你的手更好。
lines.en: Your bait is good, but your hand is better.

lines.zh: 我追着那点腥味游过来。
lines.en: I chase that faint bloody scent over here.

lines.zh: 有肉就行，别的我不问。
lines.en: Meat will do; I ask nothing else of it.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在钩上，我看到了钩。
lines.en: You hang the fish on a hook, and I see the hook.

lines.zh: 食物在水里散开，我张嘴吞了。
lines.en: The food spreads through the water, and I open wide and swallow.

lines.zh: 我咬住诱饵，也咬住了线。
lines.en: I bite the bait, and the line along with it.

lines.zh: 吃完后我会留下一颗牙，当作回礼。
lines.en: When I finish, I leave a tooth behind as a thank-you.

lines.zh: 你踩进河里，撞开了我。
lines.en: You step into the river and knock me aside.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过，牙齿刮到裤脚。
lines.en: I brush past your leg, teeth catching your trouser cuff.

lines.zh: 我的身体很硬，你的膝盖会知道。
lines.en: My body is hard, and your knee will find out.

lines.zh: 碰到一起，退开的是你，不是我。
lines.en: We meet with a thud, and the one backing off is you.

lines.zh: 河太窄，我们只能贴着过去。
lines.en: The river is too narrow, so we must pass pressed together.

lines.zh: 你踢水，我被推得转了个身。
lines.en: You kick the water, and I am spun around.

lines.zh: 我顶了你的小腿一下，很轻，像警告。
lines.en: I butt your calf lightly, like a warning.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍划过你的手背，留下白痕。
lines.en: My dorsal fin rakes your hand and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 你别站在河心，那里是我的路。
lines.en: Do not stand midstream; that is my road.

lines.zh: 我们碰过之后，水里有淡淡的血味。
lines.en: After we collide, the water tastes faintly of blood.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转圈，牙齿都收着。
lines.en: We circle each other with our teeth held back.

lines.zh: 她比我长，游起来像一把更快的锯。
lines.en: She is longer than me and swims like a faster saw.

lines.zh: 交配时我们不咬对方，这是规矩。
lines.en: We do not bite each other while mating; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 河湾最深处，是我们产卵的地方。
lines.en: The deepest part of the bend is where we lay eggs.

lines.zh: 我用侧腹碰她，她回碰了一下。
lines.en: I touch her with my flank, and she touches back.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会粘在石缝里，很隐蔽。
lines.en: Our eggs will cling in a stone crack, well hidden.

lines.zh: 这个季节，河里有很多对这样的鱼。
lines.en: This season, the river holds many pairs like us.

lines.zh: 她游走后，我还在原地待了很久。
lines.en: After she leaves, I stay in place for a long while.

lines.zh: 后代一出生就有两排牙。
lines.en: Our young are born with two rows of teeth.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着石缝，直到孵化。
lines.en: We guard the crack together until they hatch.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块鱼肉，然后又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of fish and put it down again.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在牙缝里，我甩头去弄。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my teeth, and I shake my head at it.

lines.zh: 一颗掉落的牙沉到河底，我看了看。
lines.en: A fallen tooth sinks to the riverbed, and I look at it.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖到石头后面。
lines.en: I drag my catch behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我咬住那根线，被扯了一下。
lines.en: I bite the line and get yanked once.

lines.zh: 我捡不起什么，我的嘴只用来咬。
lines.en: I cannot pick much up; my mouth is only for biting.

lines.zh: 那块骨头太硬，我放弃了。
lines.en: That bone is too hard, so I give up on it.

lines.zh: 我把鱼拖进草丛，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I drag the fish into the weeds and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 有片亮的东西沉下来，我咬了一下。
lines.en: Something bright sinks down, and I bite it once.

lines.zh: 叼着东西游，会让我的牙露出来。
lines.en: Swimming with something in my mouth shows off my teeth.

lines.zh: 前面那条鱼慢下来了，我加速。
lines.en: The fish ahead slows, and I speed up.

lines.zh: 血的味道从上游来，我转头。
lines.en: The smell of blood comes from upstream, and I turn.

lines.zh: 你踩水的动作太大，我注意到了。
lines.en: Your wading is too loud, and I notice.

lines.zh: 我把目标锁定在最小的那条身上。
lines.en: I fix my target on the smallest one.

lines.zh: 鳃边的水一动，我就知道有鱼。
lines.en: The water by my gills stirs, and I know fish are near.

lines.zh: 我不挑对手，只挑离得近的。
lines.en: I do not choose opponents, only whoever is closest.

lines.zh: 那条鱼的尾巴受伤了，正好。
lines.en: That fish has an injured tail, which is convenient.

lines.zh: 我开始贴着河底靠近，不出声。
lines.en: I begin to close in along the bottom, silent.

lines.zh: 我把牙张开，让水流先过去。
lines.en: I open my teeth and let the current go first.

lines.zh: 小是小，塞牙缝够了。
lines.en: Small, yes, but enough to fill the gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我停在它侧后方，等它转身。
lines.en: I stop at its flank and wait for it to turn.

lines.zh: 它每次摆尾，我就前进一点。
lines.en: With every beat of its tail, I advance a little.

lines.zh: 我跟着它绕了半圈，不着急。
lines.en: I trail it around half a circle, unhurried.

lines.zh: 河水把我的味道带过去，它慌了。
lines.en: The river carries my scent to it, and it panics.

lines.zh: 我在它的盲区里，一直贴着。
lines.en: I stay in its blind spot, pressed close.

lines.zh: 它往浅水游，那里更没有退路。
lines.en: It swims to the shallows, where there is even less escape.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，牙齿在水里很显眼。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, teeth conspicuous in the water.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离只剩两格。
lines.en: Only two blocks separate us now.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的尾巴也垂下来。
lines.en: When it halts, my tail hangs still as well.

lines.zh: 它刚摆尾，我已经跟上了。
lines.en: Its tail barely flicks and I am already after it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的侧腹，牙齿陷进去。
lines.en: I bite its flank and my teeth sink in.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我的牙开始锯。
lines.en: Blood clouds the water, and my teeth begin to saw.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，它的鳞飞了两片。
lines.en: At that bite, two of its scales fly off.

lines.zh: 我侧头一扯，肉就下来了。
lines.en: I wrench my head sideways and the flesh comes free.

lines.zh: 它挣扎，我的颌骨闭得更紧。
lines.en: It fights, and my jaw shuts even tighter.

lines.zh: 我用身体压住它，牙齿继续切。
lines.en: I pin it with my body while my teeth keep cutting.

lines.zh: 咬合的声音在水下很闷。
lines.en: The sound of the bite is muffled underwater.

lines.zh: 它逃了，但游得很歪。
lines.en: It escapes, but it swims crooked.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里卡着它的骨头。
lines.en: Its bone is stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 吃完后，河底留下一颗我的牙。
lines.en: After the meal, one of my teeth is left on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我在河流的石缝里孵化，先吃虫子。
lines.en: I hatch in a river stone crack and eat bugs first.

lines.zh: 这条河够长，够我游一辈子。
lines.en: This river is long enough to swim for a lifetime.

lines.zh: 我出生时牙就已经很尖了。
lines.en: My teeth were already sharp when I was born.

lines.zh: 我从水草里钻出来，先咬了口叶子。
lines.en: I push out of the weeds and bite a leaf first.

lines.zh: 河水很清，我的影子看得见。
lines.en: The river is clear, and my shadow shows.

lines.zh: 这条河里的鱼，从今天起要小心。
lines.en: The fish in this river must be careful from today.

lines.zh: 我游进河心，那里水更深。
lines.en: I swim to midstream, where the water runs deeper.

lines.zh: 我的第一颗牙，掉在出生的石缝里。
lines.en: My first tooth fell in the crack where I was born.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼还不认识我。
lines.en: The fish in the school do not know me yet.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流往下游，去找吃的。
lines.en: I follow the current downstream, looking for food.

lines.zh: 火把伸进水里，我的鳃边一片灼痛。
lines.en: A torch dips into the water, and my gills burn.

lines.zh: 我被提出水面摔在岸上，牙齿磕断一颗。
lines.en: I am hauled out and dropped on the bank, breaking a tooth.

lines.zh: 我被晾在岸上，鳃一张一合，什么也吸不到。
lines.en: Left on the bank, my gills open and close and catch nothing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河床炸开，我被掀到浅滩。
lines.en: The blast tears the riverbed open and throws me onto the shallows.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿水面，钉在我的侧鳍上。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and pins my side fin.

lines.zh: 魔法的光锁住我，牙齿咬不动它。
lines.en: Magic light locks me in place, and my teeth cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 河里没有鱼了，我的牙开始发酸。
lines.en: There are no fish left in the river, and my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 雷打进河心，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes midstream, and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 河底裂开，我掉进黑里，牙咬着空气。
lines.en: The riverbed splits; I fall into the dark, teeth biting air.
